formats.key: approve(address spender, uint256 value)
effects: Sets the signer's zkUSD allowance for spender to value (max uint256 = never decreases).
formats.shown: Approve <amount or Unlimited> zkUSD for <spender>.

formats.key: encryptedToPublicTransfer((bytes proof,(uint256 x,uint256 y) senderEpk,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) newSenderBalanceCt,address recipient,uint256 amount) params, (bool clear,bool enabled) flags)
effects: Debits params.amount from the encrypted balance of the signer's EPK (signer must be its controller) and sets it to newSenderBalanceCt.
Mints params.amount public zkUSD to params.recipient (or to the recipient's auto-encrypt EPK if they enabled it).
If flags.clear, folds the signer's pending balance into the active encrypted balance.
Sets pending routing of the signer's EPK to flags.enabled, which can turn pending routing off.
formats.shown: Send <amount> zkUSD to <recipient>, under the intent 'Transfer (encrypted to public)'.

findings.title: encryptedToPublicTransfer hides flags.clear and flags.enabled, which change the signer's pending-balance routing.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol _handlePendingFlags: `if (flags.clear) { _clearPending(compressed); } ... if (pendingActive != flags.enabled) { $.pendingActive[compressed] = flags.enabled; }`. The descriptor has no field for flags.
findings.fix: Add fields for `flags.clear` ('Merge pending balance') and `flags.enabled` ('Pending routing after tx'), with labels that say true/false is the end state.

formats.key: encryptedToPublicTransferWithAuth((bytes proof,(uint256 x,uint256 y) senderEpk,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) newSenderBalanceCt,address recipient,uint256 amount) params, (bool clear,bool enabled) flags, (uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline,bytes signature) auth)
effects: Consumes the EPK controller's signed authorization (nonce).
Debits params.amount from the encrypted balance of params.senderEpk, which belongs to the controller, not to the transaction sender.
Mints params.amount public zkUSD to params.recipient.
Applies flags.clear and flags.enabled to the sender EPK's pending balance and routing.
formats.shown: Send <amount> zkUSD to <recipient>, under the intent 'Encrypted to public (auth)'.

findings.title: encryptedToPublicTransferWithAuth says 'Send X to Bob' without naming whose encrypted balance pays.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol encryptedToPublicTransferWithAuth: `(address controller, CompressedPoint compressedSender) = _validateEpk(params.senderEpk); ... _consumeAuthorization(controller, digest, auth);`. Descriptor: interpolatedIntent 'Send {params.amount} to {params.recipient}'; no senderEpk field. The sibling publicToEncryptedTransferWithAuth shows 'from {owner}'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Relay encrypted-to-public transfer' and add a 'From ZK key' field on `params.senderEpk.x`.

findings.title: encryptedToPublicTransferWithAuth hides the pending-balance flags it applies to the sender EPK.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol encryptedToPublicTransferWithAuth: `_handlePendingFlags(compressedSender, flags);`. The descriptor has no field for flags.
findings.fix: Add fields for `flags.clear` and `flags.enabled`.

formats.key: encryptedToPublicTransferWithCallerAuth((bytes proof,(uint256 x,uint256 y) senderEpk,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) newSenderBalanceCt,address recipient,uint256 amount) params, (bool clear,bool enabled) flags, (uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline,bytes signature) auth)
effects: Consumes the controller's authorization, which is bound to msg.sender.
Debits params.amount from the encrypted balance of params.senderEpk (the controller's).
Mints params.amount public zkUSD to params.recipient.
Applies flags.clear and flags.enabled to the sender EPK's pending balance and routing.
formats.shown: Send <amount> zkUSD to <recipient>, under the intent 'Encrypted to public (caller)'.

findings.title: encryptedToPublicTransferWithCallerAuth says 'Send X to Bob' without naming the paying encrypted account.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol encryptedToPublicTransferWithCallerAuth: `_consumeAuthorization(controller, digest, auth); _encryptedToPublicTransfer(params, compressedSender, auxCommitment);`. Descriptor: 'Send {params.amount} to {params.recipient}', with no senderEpk field.
findings.fix: Add a 'From ZK key' field on `params.senderEpk.x`, and use an intent that says the call relays the transfer.

findings.title: encryptedToPublicTransferWithCallerAuth hides the pending-balance flags it applies.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol encryptedToPublicTransferWithCallerAuth: `_handlePendingFlags(compressedSender, flags);`. The descriptor has no flags field.
findings.fix: Add fields for `flags.clear` and `flags.enabled`.

formats.key: encryptedTransfer((bytes proof,(uint256 x,uint256 y) senderEpk,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) newSenderBalanceCt,(uint256 x,uint256 y) recipientEpk,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) recipientAmountCt,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) trcAmountCt) params, (bool clear,bool enabled) flags)
effects: Replaces the signer's EPK encrypted balance with newSenderBalanceCt, which debits an encrypted amount.
Credits the encrypted amount recipientAmountCt to recipientEpk (to its active or pending slot).
Applies flags.clear and flags.enabled to the signer EPK's pending balance and routing.
formats.shown: 'Encrypted transfer' with the recipient key shown as two raw 32-byte hex values.

findings.title: encryptedTransfer cannot show the amount sent, because the calldata holds only ElGamal ciphertexts.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol _encryptedTransfer: `_addToEpkBalance(compressedRecipient, params.recipientAmountCt);`. The amount exists only as ciphertext and a ZK proof.

findings.title: encryptedTransfer hides flags.clear and flags.enabled, which change the signer's pending routing.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol encryptedTransfer: `_handlePendingFlags(senderCompressedEpk, flags);`. The descriptor has fields only for recipientEpk.x and recipientEpk.y.
findings.fix: Add fields for `flags.clear` and `flags.enabled`.

findings.title: encryptedTransfer shows the recipient only as two raw 64-hex-character coordinates, 'To key x' and 'To key y'.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: paths 'params.recipientEpk.x.[0:32]' and 'params.recipientEpk.y.[0:32]' with format raw. Case 4 shows two 0x… 32-byte values.
findings.fix: Show only `params.recipientEpk.x` with the label 'To ZK key', and state in the intent that the amount is encrypted.

formats.key: encryptedTransferWithAuth((bytes proof,(uint256 x,uint256 y) senderEpk,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) newSenderBalanceCt,(uint256 x,uint256 y) recipientEpk,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) recipientAmountCt,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) trcAmountCt) params, (bool clear,bool enabled) flags, (uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline,bytes signature) auth)
effects: Consumes the sender controller's authorization.
Debits an encrypted amount from params.senderEpk and credits recipientAmountCt to recipientEpk.
Applies flags to the sender EPK's pending balance and routing.
formats.shown: 'Encrypted transfer (auth)' with the recipient key as two raw hex values.

findings.title: encryptedTransferWithAuth cannot show the amount, which is encrypted in the calldata.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol _encryptedTransfer: `_addToEpkBalance(compressedRecipient, params.recipientAmountCt);`.

findings.title: encryptedTransferWithAuth shows neither the paying sender EPK nor the pending flags.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol encryptedTransferWithAuth: `_consumeAuthorization(senderController, digest, auth); ... _handlePendingFlags(senderCompressedEpk, flags);`. The descriptor has fields only for recipientEpk x and y.
findings.fix: Add 'From ZK key' on `params.senderEpk.x`, and add fields for `flags.clear` and `flags.enabled`.

findings.title: encryptedTransferWithAuth shows the recipient as two raw hex coordinates.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: 'params.recipientEpk.x.[0:32]' and 'params.recipientEpk.y.[0:32]' format raw; case 5.
findings.fix: Show only `params.recipientEpk.x` as 'To ZK key'.

formats.key: encryptedTransferWithCallerAuth((bytes proof,(uint256 x,uint256 y) senderEpk,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) newSenderBalanceCt,(uint256 x,uint256 y) recipientEpk,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) recipientAmountCt,((uint256 x,uint256 y) R,(uint256 x,uint256 y) C) trcAmountCt) params, (bool clear,bool enabled) flags, (uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline,bytes signature) auth)
effects: Consumes the sender controller's authorization, which is bound to msg.sender.

formats.shown: 'Encrypted transfer (caller)' with the recipient key as two raw hex values.

findings.title: encryptedTransferWithCallerAuth cannot show the amount, which is encrypted in the calldata.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol _encryptedTransfer: `_addToEpkBalance(compressedRecipient, params.recipientAmountCt);`.

findings.title: encryptedTransferWithCallerAuth shows neither the sender EPK nor the pending flags.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol encryptedTransferWithCallerAuth: `_handlePendingFlags(senderCompressedEpk, flags);`. The descriptor has fields only for recipientEpk x and y.
findings.fix: Add 'From ZK key' on `params.senderEpk.x`, and add fields for `flags.clear` and `flags.enabled`.

findings.title: encryptedTransferWithCallerAuth shows the recipient as two raw hex coordinates.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: 'params.recipientEpk.x.[0:32]' and 'params.recipientEpk.y.[0:32]' format raw; case 6.

findings.title: executeEncryptedBurn cannot show the amount burned, because it is encrypted.

findings.title: initialize already ran in the proxy constructor, so every signer's call reverts.
findings.evidence: Proxy meta.json constructor _data starts with 0x4cd88b76 (initialize). ZKEMT.sol: `function initialize(...) external initializer`.
findings.fix: Remove the format.

formats.key: managePendingBalance(bytes32 epk, (bool clear,bool enabled) flags)
effects: The signer must be the controller of epk.
If flags.clear, folds epk's pending balance into its active encrypted balance.

findings.title: managePendingBalance labels flags.enabled 'Enable pending', but false turns existing pending routing off.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol _handlePendingFlags: `if (pendingActive != flags.enabled) { $.pendingActive[compressed] = flags.enabled; }`. Descriptor: label 'Enable pending', format raw.
findings.fix: Rename the field to 'Pending routing after tx', and add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Set pending routing to {flags.enabled}'.

effects: Consumes the controller's authorization for epk.

findings.title: managePendingBalanceWithAuth labels flags.enabled 'Enable pending', but false disables routing.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol _handlePendingFlags: `$.pendingActive[compressed] = flags.enabled;`. Descriptor: label 'Enable pending'.
findings.fix: Rename the field to 'Pending routing after tx'.

formats.key: publicToEncryptedTransfer(uint256 amount, bytes32 epk)
effects: Burns amount public zkUSD from the signer.

findings.title: publicToEncryptedTransfer says 'Send X to encrypted', but epk can be another party's account.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol publicToEncryptedTransfer: `_validateEpk(epk); _publicToEncryptedTransfer(msg.sender, amount, epk);`. _validateEpk checks only that epk is registered, not who controls it. Descriptor: interpolatedIntent 'Send {amount} to encrypted'.
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to 'Send {amount} to ZK address {epk}', or add a label that the destination may belong to someone else.

formats.key: setAutoEncrypt(bool enabled, bytes32 epk)
effects: Binds epk as the signer's auto-encrypt target permanently: a second set reverts with AutoEncryptEpkAlreadySet, and only toggling is possible later.
When enabled, every future zkUSD transfer or mint to the signer's address is burned and credited to epk. epk can be any registered EPK, including another party's.
formats.shown: 'Set auto-encrypt' with Enabled true/false and the raw ZK address.

findings.title: setAutoEncrypt does not say the EPK binding is permanent and redirects all future incoming zkUSD.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol _setAutoEncrypt: `require($.autoEncryptEpk[owner] == COMPRESSED_IDENTITY, AutoEncryptEpkAlreadySet()); $.autoEncryptEpk[owner] = epk;`. _update: `if (to != address(0) && isAutoEncryptActive(to)) { ... super._update(from, address(0), value); _addToEpkBalance(toEpk, value);`. Descriptor: intent 'Set auto-encrypt', 'ZK address' raw.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Route incoming zkUSD to ZK address' and the label to 'ZK address (cannot be changed)'. Add an interpolatedIntent that names {epk}.

formats.key: setAutoEncryptWithAuth(address owner, bool enabled, bytes32 epk, (uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline,bytes signature) auth)
effects: Consumes owner's authorization.
Binds epk permanently as owner's auto-encrypt target and sets the active flag, which redirects future incoming zkUSD of owner to epk.
formats.shown: 'Set auto-encrypt (auth)' with Owner, Enabled and the raw ZK address.

findings.title: setAutoEncryptWithAuth does not say the owner's EPK binding is permanent and redirects incoming zkUSD.
findings.evidence: ZKEMT.sol _setAutoEncrypt: `require($.autoEncryptEpk[owner] == COMPRESSED_IDENTITY, AutoEncryptEpkAlreadySet());`. Descriptor: intent 'Set auto-encrypt (auth)'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Route owner's incoming zkUSD to ZK address' and label the epk field 'ZK address (cannot be changed)'.

findings.title: toggleAutoEncryptWithAuth cannot show the stored EPK that receives redirected funds.
